ownerDecisions.text: co-presence 宜 only when 卷十 and 卷十一 readings agree; split = SOURCE_DEPENDENT
an unknown base with every partner known absent gives no 宜 (outcome over every completion); unknown only when completions disagree

semantics.presence: true present, false absent, null unknown
semantics.d: agreed | agreed_absent | source_dependent | unknown, over every completion of the base and its partners
semantics.xiuCangKu: yi | no_yi | source_dependent | unknown, over every completion of the 18 operands (FR-04 order)
semantics.kaiCangKuYi: Kleene ANY(月恩 四相 時德 滿日 五富); 宜 only, 忌 composition is P4-B
semantics.impossible: 收日+開日 or 天倉+時德 both present -> error IMPOSSIBLE_CO_PRESENCE
semantics.propagation.kaiJi: true = 忌 must stay (百忌 甲日 專忌, puzhu:22 如遇專忌之日則仍註忌); false = puzhu:28 諸事不忌; null = ordinary 忌 composition decides
